column1: # P/04 release transition machine, N3 Transitions of release. Machine part slot-release, called for the selected fate, never before slot-fate priority checks.
# states: consider,writing,released,refused,move,wait,hung. Initial consider; writing awaits the current CAS result, all others terminal.
#var fate string — release|move|wait|hung from slot-fate. Other fates need no release transition and are returned by that machine.
#var gen_readable bool — from the existing row, no replacement with zero.
#var age double — same-version age of this judge.
#var HUNG_MOVE_AFTER double — effective setting, default 900 s.
#var version string — version of the judgement, used as CAS, never refreshed silently.
#var release_version string — version from the confirmed CAS reply, never the old judgement version.
#var reply string — pending|ok|conflict|badkey|error|blocked|unconfirmed; a non-answer is never ok/conflict.
#action result(string,string) — return fate/outcome and names_given version or empty string.

# action=- — YOURS at norm: reject unreadable gen with no write/no permission; for a readable row keep holder/until/gen/server; for a torn row write released:true,holder:"",until:0,gen as read,server if readable else ""; CAS by version.

# On unreadable gen the YOURS action feeds blocked without a write or permission. On definite error/badkey record the step failure; unconfirmed waits by store-client rules, no permission before confirmation.
# A CAS refusal caused by renewal leaves the slot untouched; the next pass observes the changed version and judges alive. No blind repeat by a newer CAS.
